newsitem.title: UK: Camas buys US aggregates firm for 19 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Camas buys US aggregates firm for 19 mln stg.

text.p: Building materials group Camas Plc said it has bought Model Stone Company, based in Minneapolis/St Paul in the U.S., for 19.4 million stg cash.
Model Stone has four ready mix plants, with a fifth under construction, a block plant and sand and gravel reserves and operations.
Camas said it will also buy about 20 years of mineral reserves on deferred terms at a fixed cost of 200,000 stg a year for each year of reserve life.
Net assets of the acquisition amount to 17 million stg and the goodwill is about five million.
It also takes on net cash balances of 200,000 stg and medium term lease commitments of 2.8 million.
The company said the deal would strengthen its position as the leading supplier of aggregate and building blocks to Minneapolis/St Paul.
Model Stone made pretax profits on a restated basis of $3.6 million in the year to December 31 1995. Turnover was $41.0 million.
